state.contract_text: This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twelve (12) months. Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives the other written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term. Notice must be sent to legal@vendor.example or by certified mail to the address in Section 12.
state.cancellation_email_text: Hi team, we've decided not to continue with the service for another year. Please treat this as our formal notice that we will not be renewing our contract. Let us know if you need anything else to process this. Thanks, Jamie
state.current_term_end_date_hint: unknown to the pipeline; must be read from contract_text plus email_received_date as the reference point

has_auto_renewal.instructions: Does `contract_text` contain a clause under which this agreement automatically renews for another term unless the customer takes some action?

criteria.true: the contract auto-renews (evergreen/auto-renewal language) absent a timely cancellation or non-renewal notice
criteria.false: the contract simply ends at the term's expiration, requires opt-in renewal, or has no renewal clause at all

required_notice_days.instructions: Per `contract_text`, how many days of advance notice must the customer give, before the end of the then-current term, to prevent automatic renewal? Bucket the stated number of days.

criteria.none: contract does not require any advance notice period to prevent renewal
criteria.unclear: contract_text does not state a clear notice period

term_end_relative_to_email.instructions: Using `contract_text` to determine the current term's length/anniversary and `email_received_date` as the reference point 'today', how many days after `email_received_date` does the current contract term (the one that would otherwise auto-renew) end?

criteria.already_ended: the current term already ended on or before email_received_date
criteria.0_15: term ends 0 to 15 days after email_received_date
criteria.16_30: term ends 16 to 30 days after email_received_date
criteria.31_45: term ends 31 to 45 days after email_received_date
criteria.46_60: term ends 46 to 60 days after email_received_date
criteria.61_90: term ends 61 to 90 days after email_received_date
criteria.91_120: term ends 91 to 120 days after email_received_date
criteria.121_plus: term ends more than 120 days after email_received_date
criteria.unclear: the current term's end date cannot be determined from contract_text

notice_method_valid.instructions: Does `contract_text` require a specific delivery method or recipient (e.g. certified mail, a named address, a specific email address) for a valid cancellation/non-renewal notice, and if so, is that requirement satisfied by `cancellation_email_text` being sent from `cancellation_email_sender` to `cancellation_email_recipient`?

criteria.true: contract_text has no specific method/recipient requirement, or the one it has is satisfied by this email
criteria.false: contract_text requires a specific method or recipient that this email does not satisfy
